name: louvorflow
description: Sistema de cifras, repertorios e modo apresentacao para equipes de louvor e musicos.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @louvorflow/shared && concurrently "npm.cmd run dev -w @louvorflow/api" "npm.cmd run dev -w @louvorflow/web"
scripts.preview: npm run build -w @louvorflow/shared && npm run build -w @louvorflow/web && concurrently "npm.cmd run dev -w @louvorflow/api" "powershell -NoProfile -Command Start-Sleep -Seconds 4; npm.cmd run preview -w @louvorflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @louvorflow/shared && npm run build -w @louvorflow/api && npm run build -w @louvorflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @louvorflow/shared && npm run typecheck -w @louvorflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @louvorflow/web
